cell.differs_boxes: {photos, plural, one {Differs: same box on {same} of # photo} other {Differs: same boxes on {same} of # photos}}

row.activation_failed: It could not be loaded, so no provider was checked. Use Repair download for this model in Settings → Identifying birds.
row.provider_sweep_failed: The check failed before any provider gave a result. Run it again; if it fails again, the container logs name the cause.
row.unknown: It was not checked, for a reason this page cannot name. The container logs name the cause.

checks.title: Provider checks

compat_only_body: This check confirmed which providers load each model and give the same answers as the CPU. It did not measure accuracy, so no accuracy figures are shown. Start an evaluation to measure accuracy.

confirm_delete.message: The results and files of the evaluation from {when} are removed from the server. This cannot be undone.
confirm_delete.title: Delete this evaluation?

confirm_stop.message: Models that were already tested keep their results, and the model you use now is put back.
confirm_stop.title: Stop the evaluation?

how.checks: In provider checks, each model runs on every provider this install can use, each in its own process so a crash cannot stop YA-WAMF. A bird finder is compared on where it places its box.

col.average_time: The mean time to name one photo.
col.can_name: How many of the test species the model has an answer for.
col.common: The first-guess share on widespread feeder birds.
col.first_guess: The share of photos where the first guess was the correct species.
col.local: The first-guess share on birds recorded near your location.
col.provider: The provider the model ran on.
col.slow_time: The time that 19 in 20 photos stayed under.
col.top_three: The share where the correct species was among the first three guesses.

how.cost: While it runs, YA-WAMF loads each model in turn, so naming new visits can be slower. The model you use now is put back when it ends. Fetching the photos needs internet access.
how.limit: The photos are not from your feeder. Use the figures to compare models with each other, not to predict how accurate one will be at your feeder.
how.photos: The photos come from iNaturalist and Wikimedia Commons: common feeder birds, and birds recorded near your saved location.
how.title: How this works

cause.already_running: Another evaluation is already running. Wait for it to finish, or stop it first.
cause.gone: It is no longer on the server. Refresh the page to see what is there.
cause.refused: YA-WAMF refused the request. Refresh the page and try again; if it is refused again, the container logs name the cause.
cause.server_fault: YA-WAMF hit an error while handling the request. Try again; if it keeps failing, look at the container logs.
cause.signed_out: Your sign-in has expired or is not the owner's. Sign in again, then retry.
cause.unreachable: YA-WAMF did not answer. Check that it is running and that this device can reach it, then try again.

problem.stale: What is shown below may be out of date.

what.history: The past evaluations could not be read.
what.results: The results of this evaluation could not be read.

results.capped: Only the 20 most recent evaluations are listed.
results.columns_hint: Each column is explained under How this works.
results.delete_blocked: Stop it before you delete it.
results.empty: No evaluation has been run yet. Start one above and its results appear here.
results.no_models: No model was tested in this evaluation.
results.still_running: This evaluation is still running. Results appear here as each model finishes.
results.stopped_early: This evaluation stopped before it finished, so some models may be missing.
results.title: Results
results.vocabulary_note: Shares count only the species a model can name.

skipped.activation_failed: Its files are missing or incomplete. Use Repair download for this model in Settings → Identifying birds.
skipped.other: It was skipped for a reason this page cannot name. The container logs name the cause.
skipped.reload_failed: It could not be loaded. Use Repair download for this model in Settings → Identifying birds; if that does not help, the container logs name the cause.
skipped.title: Models that were not tested

start.all_models_desc: Also checks that each model gives the same answers on your graphics chip or NPU as on the CPU. Models you have not installed are downloaded first and stay installed. This takes much longer.
start.all_models_label: Check every model on every provider
start.download_none: Every model is already installed, so nothing is downloaded.
start.download_note: The download may take a while, depending on your connection. Downloaded models stay on disk until you delete their files in Settings → Identifying birds.
start.download_reading: Reading how much would be downloaded…
start.download_size: {count, plural, one {# model is not installed yet: a download of about {size}.} other {# models are not installed yet: a download of about {size}.}}
start.download_size_partial: {count, plural, one {# model is not installed yet.} other {# models are not installed yet.}} {unknown, plural, one {# of them has no known size;} other {# of them have no known size;}} the rest are a download of about {size}.
start.download_size_unknown: {count, plural, one {# model is not installed yet. Its size is not known.} other {# models are not installed yet. Their size is not known.}}
start.download_unknown: The download size could not be read. Models you have not installed are still downloaded.
start.each_photo_desc: Adds a file with the five best guesses for every photo, so you can look into single mistakes. You can download it with the other results.
start.running_reason: One evaluation runs at a time. Stop this one to start another.
start.title: Start an evaluation
start.what: Each installed model names reference photos of known species, so you can compare how often each is right and how fast.

stopped.finder_needs_provider_check: A bird finder can only be checked for providers. Run the check from Settings → Identifying birds.
stopped.models_not_ready: A model chosen for this check is not installed and ready. Look at it in Settings → Identifying birds, then start again.
stopped.network: A request to iNaturalist or Wikimedia Commons failed. Check the internet connection, then start again.
stopped.no_models: No bird model is installed and ready. Install one in Settings → Identifying birds, then start again.
stopped.no_test_birds: The list of test birds could not be built because iNaturalist did not answer. Check the internet connection, then start again.
stopped.no_test_photos: No test photo could be fetched from iNaturalist or Wikimedia Commons. Check the internet connection, then start again.
stopped.unexpected: It stopped on an error this page cannot name. Start it again; if it stops again, the container logs name the cause.

warning.high_abstention: Gave no species for {share}% of the photos. It may not cover these birds, or its install may be incomplete. Check the model in Settings → Identifying birds.
warning.incomplete_install: Its files are incomplete. Use Repair download for this model in Settings → Identifying birds.
warning.inference_health_unhealthy: Errors or timeouts happened while it ran. Look at the container logs for the cause.
warning.latency_drift_high: Much slower than when it was loaded: {measured, number} ms a photo against {loaded, number} ms. The provider it ran on may be failing. Set the inference provider to CPU in Settings → Identifying birds and evaluate again.
warning.latency_drift_high_plain: Much slower than when it was loaded. The provider it ran on may be failing. Set the inference provider to CPU in Settings → Identifying birds and evaluate again.
warning.low_shared_core: Named fewer than half of the common feeder birds correctly, which usually means a broken install. Use Repair download for this model in Settings → Identifying birds.
warning.partial_vocabulary: Cannot name {outside} of the {total} test species, usually because they live outside its region. Its shares cover the species it can name.
warning.partial_vocabulary_plain: Cannot name some of the test species, usually because they live outside its region. Its shares cover the species it can name.
warning.provider_fallback_active: Ran on the CPU although a faster provider was asked for. Runtime diagnostics in Settings → Identifying birds gives the reason.
warning.provider_validation_failed: No provider gave usable answers that matched the CPU. Provider checks below shows each result.
warning.provider_validation_partial: Some providers failed or are not available here. Provider checks below shows each result.
warning.region_mismatch: Built for a different region than the birds near you, so its shares here are lower than they would be there.
warning.unknown: Flagged for a reason this version of the page cannot explain. The Summary download has the detail.
